text:
Leah (partnerships): Quick sync for the new marketplace onboarding. Need image naming convention, SKU splits, and trial mapping before we send the partner checklist.
Tom (eng-cloud): Suggested naming: redwood-inference-{region}-{arch}-{build}. Example: redwood-inference-us-east-1-x86_64-20250312. We'll provide AMIs + GCE image names.
Priya (marketing): I'll prepare hero blurb + three screenshots. Need image aspect ratio and exact favicon (16x16). Can teams confirm pixel requirements?
Gus (legal): For Azure offers we must host a versioned EULA and DPA link. We'll need signer and date on the EULA. Also confirm trial data retention policy.
Leah (partnerships): Proposed trial: 14-day entitlement SKU, auto-convert to paid unless customer cancels. Is that acceptable?
Tom (eng-cloud): Works. Also recommend separate SKUs per region to track usage. We'll supply Terraform snippet for publisher role (least privilege) and the role ARN.
Marketplace-bot: staging-image-publish succeeded -> 1750200160.
Gus (legal): I'll add a short trial clause to EULA and publish at docs.redwood.ai/legal/eula/v2.0. Will include contact: legal@redwood.ai.
Priya (marketing): Assets ETA: today 5pm PT. I'll upload hero.png (1600x600), thumb (640x360), logo.svg and favicon.
Leah (partnerships): Blockers? If not, I'll draft partner checklist and schedule demo call tomorrow 11am PT.
Tom (eng-cloud): Blocker: need QA to run AMI parity script. I'll open PR and tag QA.
Gus (legal): Blocker: partner asked for 45-day payout terms; finance escalation may be needed.
Leah (partnerships): Action items: 1) Tom -> PR with ARN + Terraform, 2) Priya -> upload assets, 3) Gus -> publish EULA v2.0 and confirm DPA link, 4) Partnerships -> send checklist + call invite. I'll follow up in vendor call. :metal:
